title: Account Manager
jobDescription:
Join Kale Logistics Solutions:

Incorporated in 2010, Kale Logistics Solutions is a trusted global cloud-based tech provider for several Fortune 500 companies worldwide, offering a comprehensive suite of tech solutions for the logistics industry. With in-depth domain knowledge and technical expertise, Kale has created a suite of comprehensive enterprise systems and Cargo Community Platforms, which offer a single electronic window capable of supporting operational flows, percolating data to various stakeholders, and facilitating the paperless exchange of trade-related information between stakeholders.

Kale’s community and enterprise solutions cater to a wide network of Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) and help strengthen and improve their operational and business capabilities. With offices in India, UAE, Kenya, Netherlands, and North America with 5,500+ clients worldwide across 40 countries, Kale Logistics Solutions is a major player in the industry.

About the ROLE: Manage and grow strategic customer relationships across its software products and technology solutions portfolio Manage and grow strategic customer relationships across its software products and technology solutions portfolio

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and manage relationships with assigned customer accounts as the primary point of contact.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives, challenges, and technology roadmaps.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and executive sponsors.
  • Conduct periodic business reviews and account planning sessions to drive customer engagement and satisfaction.
  • Identify and drive cross-sell opportunities across the organization's software products, Saa S solutions, implementation services, support services, and digital transformation offerings.
  • Drive upsell opportunities by expanding existing engagements, introducing new modules, increasing user adoption, and positioning higher-value solutions.
  • Prepare account growth plans and execute strategies to increase wallet share within existing customers.
  • Achieve account revenue, renewal, retention, and profitability targets.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, Delivery, and Implementation teams to ensure successful solution adoption and customer outcomes.
  • Monitor account health, customer satisfaction, project performance, risks, and escalations.
  • Lead contract renewal discussions, commercial negotiations, and pricing reviews.
  • Track customer usage, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively recommend value-added solutions.
  • Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution through coordination with internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate account forecasts, pipeline visibility, and CRM updates.
  • Gather customer feedback and market intelligence to support product improvements and business strategy.
  • Ensure timely collection of receivables and support commercial governance activities.
  • Maintain long-term customer relationships that contribute to recurring revenue growth and customer advocacy.

Who You Are:

  • 5-7 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, IT Services, Saa S, Enterprise Software, or Technology Consulting.

  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or mid-market customer accounts.

  • Demonstrated success in driving account growth through cross-selling, upselling, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Saa S business models, Agile methodologies, and enterprise software solutions.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Hub Spot, Zoho, or Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

Education

  • Any graduate.

  • MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Sales, Marketing, Business Management, or related discipline is preferred.

Preferred Domain Knowledge

  • Saa S Products and Enterprise Software

  • Software Development Services

  • Digital Transformation Solutions

  • Cloud Technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP)

  • Application Development and Product Engineering

  • Logistics, Supply Chain, Cargo, Airport, or Port Operations (preferred)

Why Join Us:

  • Empowerment and Growth: We provide opportunities for continuous learning and development to help you perform at your best.

  • Inclusive Culture: We celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected.

  • Innovation: Be part of a team that is driving innovation in the logistics industry with cutting-edge technology solutions.

  • Global Impact: Work on projects that have a significant impact on global trade and logistics, contributing to the efficiency and sustainability of the industry.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobDescription:

Incorporated in 2010, Kale Logistics Solutions is a trusted global cloud-based tech provider for several Fortune 500 companies worldwide, offering a comprehensive suite of tech solutions for the logistics industry. What You Will Do

· Collaborate with product managers, developers, and QA teams in an agile environment to deliver high-quality designs within sprint timelines.

· Build or support the creation of HTML/CSS components for rapid prototyping or front-end alignment.

· Stay updated with design trends and apply best practices to enhance usability and consistency.

What You Will Bring

· 8+ years of experience, with strong hands-on expertise in UI/UX design for enterprise Saa S products.

· Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, and related design/prototyping tools.

· Experience using AI-based tools for UI exploration, design variations, accessibility checks, or rapid prototyping.

· Solid understanding of modern UX principles, responsive design, interaction design, and usability best practices.

· Working knowledge of HTML and CSS to support design development.

· Strong portfolio demonstrating ability to solve complex design problems and create intuitive user journeys.
